title: Fans
error.body: omafan needs NBFC-Linux with a config for this laptop and its service running:
hint: F switches fan · S silent mode · A auto · O off · T turbo · 1–9 = 10–90% · 0 = 100% · ↑↓ ±5%. Past the critical temperature NBFC runs the fan at full speed anyway.
silent.label: Keep the fans quiet
silent.off: Holds the fans at 1 % in a loop, even after a reboot. Back to auto at 95 °C.
silent.on: On, also after a reboot. Picking a mode above turns it off.
silent.tune: Quieter still (CPU boost off, critical at 98 °C), in a terminal:
